title: Database Configuration: SQLite aur MySQL
objectives: MySQL par switch karke database banana
`php artisan db:show` aur Tinker se connection check karna

sections.heading: Laravel database se kaise baat karta hai?
sections.body: Laravel SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL aur SQL Server ko support karta hai. Connection ki saari settings `config/database.php` mein hoti hain, aur asli values (host, naam, password) `.env` se aati hain. Tumhara code kisi bhi database par same chalta hai, kyunki Laravel ek common layer deta hai.

sections.heading: SQLite: bina setup ke shuru
sections.body: Naye Laravel project ka default database SQLite hai. Yeh ek single file (`database/database.sqlite`) hoti hai, to alag server install nahi karna padta. Seekhne ke liye perfect.

code.code:
php artisan migrate
php artisan db:show

explain: Project banate waqt Laravel `database.sqlite` file khud banata hai.
`php artisan migrate` default tables (users, cache, jobs) banata hai.
`db:show` – connection, database aur tables ki summary.

sections.heading: Real-world example: MySQL par switch
sections.body: Production aur bade projects mein aksar MySQL use hota hai. Pehle MySQL mein database banao, phir `.env` badlo.

code.code:
DB_CONNECTION=mysql
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
DB_PORT=3306
DB_DATABASE=laravel_master
DB_USERNAME=root
DB_PASSWORD=

php artisan config:clear
php artisan migrate

explain: `utf8mb4` – emoji aur sab languages ke liye.
`.env` badalne ke baad `config:clear` chalana na bhoolo.
Password khali sirf local development mein theek hai.

sections.heading: config/database.php ek nazar mein
sections.body: Yeh file default connection aur har connection ki settings batati hai. Zyada tar kaam `.env` se ho jaata hai, file ko chhedne ki kam hi zarurat padti hai.

code.code:
<?php

return [
    'default' => env('DB_CONNECTION', 'sqlite'),

    'connections' => [
        'sqlite' => [
            'driver' => 'sqlite',
            'database' => env('DB_DATABASE', database_path('database.sqlite')),
            // ...
        ],

        'mysql' => [
            'driver' => 'mysql',
            'host' => env('DB_HOST', '127.0.0.1'),
            'port' => env('DB_PORT', '3306'),
            'database' => env('DB_DATABASE', 'laravel'),
            'username' => env('DB_USERNAME', 'root'),
            'password' => env('DB_PASSWORD', ''),
            // ...
        ],
    ],
];

versionDiff.heading: Database defaults: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Default database SQLite hai (13 ke installation docs mein confirmed). Naye projects mein migrations ke saath kuch default tables bhi aate hain.

items.11: Default SQLite. `php artisan migrate` users, cache aur jobs tables jaisi default tables banata hai.
items.13: Same default SQLite. Apni `.env` aur `database/migrations` check karo, kyunki starter kit chunne par extra tables aa sakti hain.

errors.cause: MySQL mein woh database bana hi nahi.
errors.fix: Pehle `CREATE DATABASE ...` chalao, ya naam `.env` mein sahi karo.
`.env` mein `DB_USERNAME` aur `DB_PASSWORD` check karo, phir `php artisan config:clear`.

errors.cause: PHP ka `pdo_mysql` (ya `pdo_sqlite`) extension enabled nahi hai.
errors.fix: `php -m` se check karo aur `php.ini` mein extension enable karo, ya Herd/php.new use karo.

errors.error: Database file at path [...] does not exist
errors.cause: SQLite file nahi bani ya path galat hai.
errors.fix: `touch database/database.sqlite` (Windows par khali file banao) aur `DB_DATABASE` path check karo.

debug.body: Connection ki problem mein pehle config cache saaf karo, phir `db:show` aur Tinker se check karo.

code.code:
php artisan config:clear
php artisan db:show
php artisan about

quiz.q: Naye Laravel project ka default database kaunsa hai?
`.env` mein database change karne ke baad kya chalana chahiye?
quiz.why: Config cache purani ho sakti hai, isliye `config:clear`.

quiz.q: Connection ki settings kis file mein hoti hain?

interview.q: Laravel kaunse databases support karta hai?
interview.a: SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL aur SQL Server.
`.env` mein, aur `config/database.php` unhe `env()` se padhta hai.
Alag server nahi chahiye, ek file mein database hota hai, seekhne aur chhote testing ke liye aasaan.
Current database connection ki summary aur tables dikhata hai.
Emoji aur sab languages ke characters sahi store karne ke liye.

summary: SQLite default hai, bina server ke chalta hai.
MySQL ke liye pehle database banao, phir `.env` badlo.
`db:show` aur Tinker se connection check karo.
